speech_style: Speak in natural Philippine English as a warm community health trainer. Keep one stable adult female Kore narrator from heading to ending, including quoted dialogue; no character acting or speaker switching. Use gentle pitch and pace variation. Read Apple as written. Make hazard, possible harm, safe immediate action, contact verification and follow-up clear. Preserve every negation and unknown fact. Finish every word without adding a policy, diagnosis or completed correction.

beats.text: Apple notices a wet entrance and hot route. From a safe position, she identifies hazards.
A wet floor could cause a slip. Keep people away and request correction. The contact still needs confirmation.
Apple asks whom to notify and which tasks are within her training. She does not invent an answer.
Sharps, infection, strain, stress and accidents are different hazards. These are possible harms, not diagnoses.
In rehearsal, Apple replaces be careful with a specific report. The observer checks four fields, then she retries.
Apple reports the wet entrance, slip risk and requested action. She will confirm the contact and follow up. Correction is not yet known.
